'''Meleenium''' was a substance found naturally only on the high-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]]. This mineral was used in trace amounts for the production of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]. During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] era, [[Vulca Minerals]] sent one [[Starship/Legends|ship]] a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] to Af'El to trade fresh [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] to the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] in return for small amounts of this rare substance.
